topic: HAProxy排队预算与运行时证据
title: 配置并验证HAProxy有界排队，解释CPU低时的等待延迟
body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root Linux及原生HAProxy；backend.cfg为故障配置。验收注入`${UPSTREAM_PORT}`，只启动1线程HAProxy与回环高端口源站，stats.sock和日志仅本题目录。

## 操作任务
提交仅含backend app的backend.cfg配置片段，平台负责固定本题frontend监听、全局资源限制、原生访问日志与stats socket。保留option http-server-close，后端origin使用127.0.0.1:${UPSTREAM_PORT}，服务容量maxconn=1不得随意放大；为请求排队配置200ms预算。第一个真实HTTP请求占住唯一上游槽位后，第二个必须真的进入HAProxy队列；到期返回503且不发到上游，正在服务的第一个请求仍正常结束。槽位释放后新请求应恢复200。用实际stats qcur和日志Tw/终止标志证明排队超时，不能用静态return503伪装，也不能把CPU低当作没有排队。本题只证明受控容量1的入口排队边界，不测真实生产吞吐。

## 提交产物
backend.cfg配置；运行后平台保留queue-observation.json和access.log作为真实状态证据。仅允许backend声明、option http-server-close、timeout queue、server origin这四行配置（可带空行/注释），不提交全局监听或外部脚本。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py以单线程HAProxy和真实回环HTTP源站验收：观察原生qcur>0，第二个请求约200ms后503（调度容差120～800ms）、来源请求计数无新增、首请求不断开、队列归零、新请求恢复200，以及日志Tw与sQ队列终止证据。无后台残留。 全部断言通过返回0。

失败示例：只提高maxconn会越过源站容量，第二请求直接进入源站；不设置独立queue预算则请求排队过久。
answer:
```haproxy
backend app
    option http-server-close
    timeout queue 200ms
    server origin 127.0.0.1:${UPSTREAM_PORT} maxconn 1
```

队列超时与连接/服务端读超时不同；保留源站并发上限，用有界等待快速明确失败。qcur是实时排队数，Tw与sQ用于核对此次503来自排队阶段。参考：[HAProxy官方过载保护说明](https://www.haproxy.com/documentation/haproxy-configuration-tutorials/performance/overload-protection/)。

原理说明：
按请求链路拆分 DNS、连接、TLS、入口排队、应用处理和依赖调用时间；关联连接池等待、磁盘I/O、锁竞争、线程池队列及下游延迟。先对齐时间窗口、请求类型与分位数，避免平均值掩盖少数慢请求。通过日志或追踪定位主要等待段后提出针对性缓解，限制并发或回退变更需有阈值与回滚条件。验收对比同等负载下的延迟分位数、错误率和吞吐。

review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。

files.backend.cfg:
backend app
    option http-server-close
    timeout queue 2s
    server origin 127.0.0.1:${UPSTREAM_PORT} maxconn 1

solution_files.backend.cfg:
backend app
    option http-server-close
    timeout queue 200ms
    server origin 127.0.0.1:${UPSTREAM_PORT} maxconn 1

negative_files.backend.cfg:
backend app
    option http-server-close
    timeout queue 200ms
    server origin 127.0.0.1:${UPSTREAM_PORT} maxconn 2

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,subprocess,socket,time,threading,http.server,http.client,json,re,csv,io
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd();fragment=pathlib.Path('backend.cfg').read_text()
# Only a backend fragment is submitted. The trusted fixture owns listeners, logs and stats socket.
lines=[line.strip() for line in fragment.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith('#')]
assert lines and lines[0]=='backend app'
allowed=[r'option http-server-close',r'timeout queue [0-9]+(?:ms|s)',r'server origin 127\.0\.0\.1:\$\{UPSTREAM_PORT\} maxconn [0-9]+']
assert len(lines)==4 and all(any(re.fullmatch(pattern,line) for pattern in allowed) for line in lines[1:]),'submit only the stated backend fragment'
hold=threading.Event();release=threading.Event();lock=threading.Lock();hits=[];workers=[]
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version='HTTP/1.1'
    def do_GET(self):
        with lock:hits.append(self.path)
        if self.path=='/hold':hold.set();release.wait(4)
        body=('origin:'+self.path).encode();self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.send_header('Connection','close');self.end_headers()
        try:self.wfile.write(body)
        except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError):pass
    def log_message(self,*args):pass
origin=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);origin_worker=threading.Thread(target=origin.serve_forever)
with socket.socket() as free:free.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));front_port=free.getsockname()[1]
wrapper='''global
    nbthread 1
    maxconn 16
    log stdout format raw local0
    stats socket unix@./stats.sock mode 600 level operator
defaults
    mode http
    log global
    timeout connect 1s
    timeout client 4s
    timeout server 4s
    log-format "%ST %Tw %tsc"
frontend incoming
    bind 127.0.0.1:FRONT_PORT
    default_backend app
'''.replace('FRONT_PORT',str(front_port))
pathlib.Path('runtime.cfg').write_text(wrapper+fragment.replace('${UPSTREAM_PORT}',str(origin.server_port)))
checked=subprocess.run(['haproxy','-c','-f','runtime.cfg'],capture_output=True,timeout=3)
assert checked.returncode==0,(checked.stdout.decode(),checked.stderr.decode())
log=open('access.log','wb');process=subprocess.Popen(['haproxy','-db','-f','runtime.cfg'],stdout=log,stderr=log)
origin_worker.start()
def request(path,result):
    started=time.monotonic();connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',front_port,timeout=3)
    try:
        connection.request('GET',path);response=connection.getresponse();result.update(status=response.status,body=response.read(),elapsed=time.monotonic()-started)
    except Exception as error:result['error']=repr(error)
    finally:connection.close()
def stats():
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.settimeout(1);sock.connect('stats.sock');sock.sendall(b'show stat\n');sock.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR);data=b''
        while True:
            part=sock.recv(16384)
            if not part:break
            data+=part
    return list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data.decode().replace('# pxname,','pxname,',1))))
try:
    for _ in range(100):
        assert process.poll() is None,pathlib.Path('access.log').read_text()
        if pathlib.Path('stats.sock').exists():break
        time.sleep(.01)
    else:raise AssertionError('HAProxy did not become ready')
    first={};t1=threading.Thread(target=request,args=('/hold',first));workers.append(t1);t1.start();assert hold.wait(1),'held request did not reach origin'
    second={};t2=threading.Thread(target=request,args=('/queued',second));workers.append(t2);t2.start()
    queued=False;observations=[]
    for _ in range(30):
        rows=[row for row in stats() if row['pxname']=='app'];observations.append(rows)
        if any(int(row.get('qcur') or 0)>0 for row in rows):queued=True;break
        if not t2.is_alive():break
        time.sleep(.005)
    assert queued,'the second request must really enter the native HAProxy queue'
    t2.join(1);assert not t2.is_alive(),'queue wait not bounded'
    assert second.get('status')==503 and .12<=second['elapsed']<.8,second
    assert hits==['/hold'],'timed-out queue request must not consume another origin slot'
    assert t1.is_alive(),'the successful in-flight request was aborted'
    after=[row for row in stats() if row['pxname']=='app'];assert all(int(row.get('qcur') or 0)==0 for row in after)
    release.set();t1.join(2);assert first.get('status')==200 and first.get('body')==b'origin:/hold',first
    normal={};request('/after',normal);assert normal.get('status')==200 and normal.get('body')==b'origin:/after',normal
    for _ in range(50):
        content=pathlib.Path('access.log').read_text(errors='replace');matches=re.findall(r'(?m)^503 ([0-9]+) (\S+)$',content)
        if matches:break
        time.sleep(.01)
    assert any(120<=int(wait)<800 and state.startswith('sQ') for wait,state in matches),content
    pathlib.Path('queue-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'during':observations,'after':after,'queue_elapsed':second['elapsed'],'status':second['status']},indent=2))
finally:
    release.set()
    for thread in workers:thread.join(3);assert not thread.is_alive()
    if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
    try:process.wait(timeout=2)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=2)
    log.close();origin.shutdown();origin.server_close();origin_worker.join(2);assert not origin_worker.is_alive()
